name: Pheneridine
summary: Pheneridine is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is related to the opioid analgesic drug pethidine (meperidine).

uses.text: Pheneridine is not currently used in medicine.

pharmacology.en: Like pethidine it acts as an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor.
pharmacology.zh: 與配西汀一樣，它是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与配西汀一样，它是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: It is one of many 4-phenylpiperidines made after pethidine, as chemists worked through variations on that accidental discovery.
fact.zh: 它是配西汀之後合成的眾多 4-苯基哌啶類之一，當時化學家正逐一嘗試那個意外發現的各種變體。
fact.zhHans: 它是配西汀之后合成的众多 4-苯基哌啶类之一，当时化学家正逐一尝试那个意外发现的各种变体。
